RATIFIED by Conti 2026-08-10 from Finn's notes/finesser/sections.draft.json; statuses reconciled to disk by Conti 2026-08-12 — all 18 fragments now exist, so every entry is live. The plugin registers [brg_<id>] for EVERY entry, so a page never shows a literal shortcode; status is documentation only (the plugin renders whatever fragment is on the CDN, and an absent one renders an invisible comment). `stacks` documents per-page shortcode order (the harness reads it; the plugin ignores it). Slot defaults, when added, must be REAL production copy.
